evidence: Source edits and manual source/API-definition review only; no builds, syntax checks, tests, project/game execution, shader compilation, GPU/API execution, process inspection or Bedrock operations

sourcePort.scope: Exactly the state changed by the current avatar_material.record_ordered implementation; not an arbitrary D3D12 state block, world/target lease or active draw insertion
captured: complete declared graphics root argument set
index buffer including an observed null binding
viewport/scissor arguments, checked for native insertion but left unchanged by restoration
sourcePort.rootLayout: CreateRootSignature now copies bounded parameter type/constant-width, descriptor range type/count/offset and root-flag metadata onto the actual returned root object using the public versioned deserializer. ARCRS002 retains ARCRS001 parameter restoration compatibility without inventing missing legacy range/flag facts; see native-descriptor-spans-source.json
sourcePort.constants: Individual and offset array root constant writes preserve exact u32 bits and per-word initialization; graphics CBV/SRV/UAV addresses retain their actual distinct parameter types
sourcePort.rootChanges: Changing a root signature clears that stage's arguments; redundant binding of the same object preserves them
sourcePort.heapChanges: Heap sets are normalized by actual descriptor type; a changed set invalidates both stages' table arguments; redundant identical sets preserve them
sourcePort.compute: Only tables are restored because the cosmetics recorder does not change compute signature/constants/root descriptors; an observed compute signature with an unknown table/layout prevents snapshots
sourcePort.readiness: Requires observed creation/reset, known pipeline/heaps, complete graphics arguments, known compute tables, defined topology and observed vertex-zero/index bindings; partial or late history cannot authorize restoration
sourcePort.lifetime: Every observed create/reset attaches a fresh monotonic private list token; snapshots and stamp checks query that live token, preventing old history from surviving a reused COM address
sourcePort.opaqueCalls: ExecuteBundle, all ExecuteIndirect calls including zero maximum count, and optional SetPipelineState1 invalidate readiness until reset
sourcePort.ownership: Shadow state owns copied PSO/root/heaps until close/reset/eviction; snapshots retain their own copies and now a complete known committed-buffer owner cohort for restored graphics root addresses and vertex/index spans when available (native-restore-buffer-owners-source.json); no command list, engine vector or guessed native resource pointer is adopted
sourcePort.tableSlotPlan: Snapshots now also retain optional bounded graphics/compute descriptor spans resolved against their actual bound heap/device/type/stride/start/count, including explicit/APPEND/unbounded ranges. Direct indexing, missing legacy flags/ranges, mixed heap classes and oversized/invalid spans remain unknown; no descriptor content/resource ownership is inferred
sourcePort.descriptorResources: Actual public heap/view/sampler and descriptor-copy observations can now supply a separately bounded retained slot/value cohort from that plan. It holds actual referenced resource objects and known committed owners; Snapshot.matches checks known revisions before emission. Overlaps/query failures remain unknown. No descriptor contents are frozen or treated as fully owned solely from this metadata (native-descriptor-resources-source.json)
sourcePort.restoration: Unsafe restore checks the captured list lifetime before writes, restores heaps/pipeline/graphics signature and arguments, compute tables and IA bindings inside the private-command guard; the future caller must pin the snapshot and referenced native assets through native retirement
sourcePort.settings: Disabled capture and unobserved/reset-less lists do not accumulate guessed state; a setting change that skips a setter invalidates that recording epoch
sourcePort.diagnostics: nativeGraphicsState reports tracked lists and scalar readiness candidates, with explicit unverified restoration/insertion/rendering flags

limitations: native_avatar_record captures/retains/restores snapshots in its source transaction, but no game-facing native insertion caller invokes it yet
The snapshot does not discover or establish world scope, native color/depth states, actual surface ownership or engine asset lifetime
Targets, viewport/scissor, compute non-table arguments and other dynamic state are outside this restore set and must remain unchanged by its caller
Opaque indirect/bundle/ray-tracing state is rejected rather than expanded; newer generic-program mutation APIs are not supported by an insertion caller

Observed public committed-buffer creation can now supply actual storage owners for a complete restored address cohort. Missing/placed buffer owners, shader read extents, mutable contents and resources referenced through descriptor tables still require the actual native owner's contract
Late root/list creation or incomplete binding initialization remains unknown; runtime hook coverage, performance and restoration fidelity are unverified
Native world rendering, complete cape/emote fidelity, deterministic video and full feature parity remain unfinished
